_doc: Site display settings. Percentile thresholds decide when a stat's title (or its flip) is awarded on a player page.
_min_role_weeks: Reset weeks a player needs in a role (all characters) to be ranked on that role: always on tank, healer and DPS achievements, and on common ones when the role filter is set. Keeps off-specs and short-lived rerolls out of the role rankings.

home._doc: pinned: achievements always shown above the Hall of fame, left out of its draw, under the pinned_title heading, with their top pinned_top_n (the first one featured). Hall of fame: featured_count achievements drawn at random on each page load. Records: big guild cards built from meta.guild_bosses; `kind` is most_kills, most_wipes, fastest_kill or slowest_kill; `exclude` lists bosses left out of a record (Razorgore: the egg phase is not in the fight length).

player._doc: Player page layout. Overview tiles come first; their stats are left out of the category sections. In each category, up to featured_per_category stats at or above featured_min_pct (or deep in flip territory) get a big card; the rest are small cards, visible_small of them shown before a 'Show more' button. An overview tile shows the percentile bar when its stat is ranked in percentile, unless its `percentile` flag says otherwise.
